title: Continuously Updating GMM in Linear IV Models: A Polynomial Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.36445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper characterizes the global minimum of the continuously updating generalized method of moments (CU-GMM) objective in linear instrumental variables models. We allow optimal weighting matrices under heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, or clustering. We show that the objective is a ratio of polynomials. For one endogenous regressor, stationary points of CU-GMM objective function are real eigenvalues of a companion matrix. Comparing their objective values with the value at infinity gives the global minimum, extending the classical eigenvector approach to limited information maximum likelihood. With multiple endogenous regressors, algebraic elimination and checks for real solutions identify the minimum among finitely many candidate objective values, including boundary values. Galois theory rules out general formulas by radicals even with one endogenous regressor and two instruments, while numerical root finding remains possible. Find

translated_title: 线性工具变量模型中的持续更新GMM：一种多项式方法
translated_abstract: 本文刻画了线性工具变量模型中持续更新广义矩估计（CU-GMM）目标函数的全局最小值。我们允许在异方差、自相关或聚类情形下使用最优加权矩阵。我们证明该目标函数是多项式之比。对于一个内生回归变量，CU-GMM目标函数的驻点是一个伴随矩阵的实特征值，将这些驻点处的目标值与无穷远处的目标值进行比较即可得到全局最小值，这将经典的特征向量方法推广至受限信息极大似然估计。对于多个内生回归变量的情形，代数消元法与实解检验可以在包括边界值在内的有限个候选目标值中识别出最小值。伽罗瓦理论表明，即使只含一个内生回归变量和两个工具变量，也不存在一般的根式求解公式，但数值求根方法仍然可行。
tldr: 本文将线性工具变量模型中CU-GMM的目标函数表示为多项式之比，通过伴随矩阵实特征值与代数消元方法刻画并求得其全局最小值。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the global minimum of the CU-GMM objective in linear IV models by expressing it as a ratio of polynomials, using real eigenvalues of companion matrices and algebraic elimination to identify the minimum.
